name: What information does an AI SEO provider need from my law firm to start?

mainEntity.name: What information does an AI SEO provider need from my law firm to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: To begin AI SEO services, a provider will typically need information about your law firm's practice areas, target clientele, geographic service areas, and current marketing goals. Access to your existing website analytics (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Search Console) and any previous SEO reports will also be crucial. Understanding your firm's unique selling propositions and competitive landscape will help tailor the AI-driven strategy effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: An AI SEO provider will need details on your law firm's practice areas, target clients, service locations, marketing goals, and access to website analytics to start.
